hero.tagline: The City of Brotherly Love Runs on Passion
hero.description: Philadelphia brings the 2026 tournament to Lincoln Financial Field, home of the Eagles and one of the most famously passionate fan bases in North American sports. Philly's working-class soccer culture, deep Eastern European and Latin communities, and iconic American history make this one of the most electrifying host cities in the draw.

stadium.name: Lincoln Financial Field
stadium.address: 1 Lincoln Financial Field Way, Philadelphia, PA 19148
stadium.transport: Lincoln Financial Field is in South Philadelphia's sports complex with excellent SEPTA Broad Street Line access. Take the orange subway to AT&T Station (now NRG Station) — a 5-minute walk to the stadium. From Center City, it's about 15 minutes. Regional Rail also connects via nearby stations.

quick_facts.matches_hosted: 6 matches — Group stage through Round of 16
quick_facts.fan_hub_status: Fan hub expected on Benjamin Franklin Parkway; confirm local schedules

weather.june: Warm and humid, highs 26–30°C (79–86°F). Occasional afternoon thunderstorms.
weather.july: Hot and humid, highs 28–32°C (82–90°F). Heavy heat and humidity — plan indoor breaks.
packing_tips: Lightweight, moisture-wicking clothing — Philly summer humidity is real
A light rain layer for afternoon storms
Sunscreen for outdoor events on the Parkway and South Street
Comfortable walking shoes — Center City is very walkable on flat ground

airports.name: Philadelphia International Airport
airports.distance_to_stadium: About 10 km from Lincoln Financial Field, 15 km from Center City
transfer_options: SEPTA Regional Rail Airport Line: PHL to Center City (30th St, Jefferson, or Market East) in 25 minutes
From Market East, transfer to Broad Street Line south to the stadium area
Rideshare from PHL to Center City hotels takes 15–30 minutes depending on traffic
Rideshare from PHL directly to the stadium is convenient on match days
airports.notes: One of the closer airports to a World Cup stadium. SEPTA Regional Rail is efficient and cheap — buy a SEPTA Key card at the airport.

public_transit: SEPTA Broad Street Line: NRG/AT&T Station — 5-minute walk to Lincoln Financial Field
Regional Rail from Airport to Center City, then Broad Street Line south
SEPTA runs extended service on major event nights
rideshare: Rideshare is practical from Center City to the stadium — about 15–20 min
Post-match surge is significant — walk a few blocks north of the complex for faster pickup
Pre-book Uber/Lyft before the match for better pricing
driving_parking: The South Philly Sports Complex has substantial parking — pre-book lots online
Pattison Ave and Broad St back up significantly after sold-out events
Parking in surrounding South Philly streets can save money but requires a longer walk
walking_biking: Not walkable from Center City hotels — 3+ miles to the complex
Bike lanes on Broad St extend close to the sports complex from Center City
match_day_tips: Broad Street Line is the fastest and cheapest option — do not drive if avoidable
The sports complex has four major venues — expect large crowds on match days
Check Eagles schedule — no NFL conflicts during the tournament
South Philly has excellent pre-match restaurants nearby on Passyunk Ave

fan_hubs.name: Benjamin Franklin Parkway Fan Hub
fan_hubs.location: Benjamin Franklin Pkwy at Eakins Oval, Philadelphia
fan_hubs.description: Philadelphia's grand boulevard, designed to resemble the Champs-Élysées, connects City Hall to the Philadelphia Museum of Art. The Eakins Oval area is expected to be the primary fan hub — giant screens, food, and entertainment with the Art Museum steps (Rocky's steps) as a backdrop.
transport_tips: SEPTA to City Hall, then short walk to the Parkway
Walking distance from Rittenhouse Square and Logan Square hotels
Multiple bus routes serve Benjamin Franklin Pkwy

fan_hubs.name: South Philly Sports Complex Area
fan_hubs.description: The pre-match energy around Lincoln Financial Field, Citizens Bank Park, and Wells Fargo Center is an event in itself. Multiple bars and outdoor spaces in the complex area fill with fans hours before kickoff.
transport_tips: Broad Street Line to Pattison Ave station
Walk from the SEPTA stop to any of the surrounding sports bars

neighborhoods.name: Center City / Rittenhouse Square
neighborhoods.safety_transit_notes: Very safe and active. The most walkable area in Philly.
neighborhoods.stadium_access: SEPTA Broad Street Line south to stadium — 20 min
neighborhoods.description: The heart of Philadelphia with the highest concentration of hotels, restaurants, and bars. Rittenhouse Square is a walkable outdoor plaza surrounded by great dining options. Best base for most World Cup visitors.

neighborhoods.name: Old City / Society Hill
neighborhoods.safety_transit_notes: Safe and historic — some of the oldest streets in America.
neighborhoods.stadium_access: SEPTA Market-Frankford Line to Broad St, then south — about 25–30 min
neighborhoods.description: Philadelphia's historic heart with Independence Hall, the Liberty Bell, and colonial architecture. Great boutique hotel options and excellent restaurants on 2nd St.

neighborhoods.name: South Philly
neighborhoods.best_for: Stadium proximity, Italian market, local culture
neighborhoods.safety_transit_notes: Generally safe in the East Passyunk corridor. Working-class neighbourhood feel.
neighborhoods.description: The neighbourhood adjacent to the sports complex. The Italian Market, East Passyunk Ave restaurant corridor, and a deeply local Philly culture. Strong soccer bar scene around game day.

neighborhoods.name: Northern Liberties / Fishtown
neighborhoods.safety_transit_notes: Safe gentrifying area — busy and active on weekends.
neighborhoods.stadium_access: Broad Street Line from Spring Garden — about 25–30 min
neighborhoods.description: Philly's most hip neighbourhood with the best craft beer bars, independent restaurants, and a young local crowd. Great for fans who want the authentic Philadelphia bar scene.

hotels.name: Loews Philadelphia Hotel
hotels.distance: 20 min to stadium via Broad Street Line
hotels.best_for: Classic luxury, Center City location, business travel

hotels.name: The Logan Philadelphia
hotels.best_for: Parkway access, rooftop bar, Penn Museum proximity

hotels.name: Kimpton Hotel Monaco Philadelphia
hotels.best_for: Boutique luxury, Old City history, independence landmarks

hotels.name: Motto by Hilton Philadelphia Rittenhouse Square

bars.name: Fado Irish Pub Philadelphia
bars.notes: Philadelphia's premier soccer bar. Packed and loud for every major match. Get there early for big games.
bars.transit: SEPTA Broad Street Line to Walnut-Locust

bars.name: The Pub on Passyunk East (POPE)
bars.notes: South Philly neighbourhood bar with a genuine local soccer crowd. Excellent for meeting Philly fans.
bars.transit: SEPTA Broad Street Line south, short walk east

bars.name: Brauhaus Schmitz
bars.notes: German beer hall with a massive indoor space and screens throughout. Great for large groups.
bars.transit: Bus from Center City to South St

bars.name: McGillin's Olde Ale House
bars.notes: Philadelphia's oldest bar (since 1860). A historic alley pub that screens soccer and draws a lively crowd.
bars.transit: Walking distance from most Center City hotels

bars.name: The Post
bars.notes: Fishtown neighbourhood bar with multiple screens and a craft beer-focused crowd.

transport.summary: Philadelphia has excellent transit with SEPTA's Broad Street Line providing direct access to Lincoln Financial Field. The Regional Rail from PHL Airport connects visitors quickly to the city. SEPTA Key card handles everything.
tips: Buy a SEPTA Key card at the airport or any station — works on all SEPTA modes
Broad Street Line to NRG/AT&T Station is the fastest way to Lincoln Financial Field
Airport to Center City via Regional Rail is 25 minutes — one of the best airport transit options in the USA
Amtrak 30th Street Station connects to NYC (1.5 hrs) and Washington DC (1.25 hrs) — easy multi-city trip

fan_zones.name: Philly Fan Hub — Benjamin Franklin Parkway
fan_zones.location: Benjamin Franklin Pkwy at Eakins Oval, Philadelphia
fan_zones.description: Philadelphia's grand Champs-Élysées-style boulevard between City Hall and the Art Museum. Giant screens and fan activities with the famous Rocky steps as backdrop.

soccer_culture.community_notes: Philadelphia has a deep soccer culture rooted in its large Eastern European, Italian, and Latin communities. The Philadelphia Union has built a real supporter culture at Subaru Park, and the city's sport-obsessed identity translates directly into passionate match-day energy.
historic_venues: Subaru Park (Chester, PA — Philadelphia Union home)

tourist_hits.name: Independence Hall & Liberty Bell
tourist_hits.notes: Core of American history — the Declaration of Independence was signed here. Free entry to the Bell, timed entry to the Hall.

tourist_hits.name: Philadelphia Museum of Art
tourist_hits.notes: World-class collection AND the Rocky steps. Run them. Everyone runs them.

tourist_hits.name: Eastern State Penitentiary
tourist_hits.notes: Haunting historic prison tour — one of the most unique tourist experiences in the USA.

tourist_hits.name: Barnes Foundation
tourist_hits.notes: Exceptional collection of Impressionist and Post-Impressionist art on the Parkway.

local_favorites.name: Italian Market (9th St)
local_favorites.notes: America's oldest outdoor market — go for cheese, fresh pasta, and the authentic South Philly experience.

local_favorites.name: Reading Terminal Market
local_favorites.notes: Legendary indoor food market in Center City — Amish vendors, DiNic's roast pork, Bassett's ice cream.

local_favorites.name: Mural Arts Program walk
local_favorites.notes: Philadelphia has over 4,000 murals — pick up a walking map or book a guided tour.

areas: East Passyunk Ave (South Philly) — the best restaurant strip in the city
Rittenhouse Square — upscale dining and cocktail bars
Fishtown / Northern Liberties — craft beer and independent restaurants
South Street — bars and late-night spots between South Philly and Society Hill

recommendations.name: Zahav
recommendations.notes: James Beard Award-winning Israeli restaurant. Book months in advance.

recommendations.name: John's Roast Pork
recommendations.notes: The definitive South Philly sandwich institution. Cash only, lunch only.

recommendations.name: Vernick Food & Drink
recommendations.notes: One of Philadelphia's best modern American restaurants.

local_resources.emergency_info: Emergency: 911. Non-emergency Philadelphia Police: (215) 686-8477. Hospital: Penn Medicine / HUP, (215) 662-4000.

walk_bike.walkability_summary: Center City is one of the most walkable downtowns in the USA. The William Penn Plan keeps it compact and flat. Rittenhouse Square, Old City, and the Parkway are all excellent walking areas.
walk_bike.bikeability_summary: Indego bikeshare operates throughout Center City and surrounding neighbourhoods. The Schuylkill River Trail is excellent for longer rides.
walk_bike.bike_share_notes: Indego Bikeshare has docks throughout Center City, Fishtown, and South Philly. Day passes available in the Indego app.

pickup_soccer.name: Capitolo Playground
pickup_soccer.location: E Passyunk Ave & Tasker St, South Philadelphia
pickup_soccer.access_notes: South Philly pickup scene with local Italian and Latino community teams on weekends.

pickup_soccer.name: Fairmount Park — Smith Memorial
pickup_soccer.access_notes: Large urban park with multiple fields and informal pickup activity.

outdoors_day_trips.name: Valley Forge National Historical Park
outdoors_day_trips.notes: Significant Revolutionary War site with beautiful trails through the historic encampment grounds.

outdoors_day_trips.name: New Hope, PA
outdoors_day_trips.notes: Charming Delaware River town with galleries, restaurants, and canal towpath cycling.

safety_tips: Philadelphia is safe in the main tourist areas — Center City, Old City, South Philly, Rittenhouse Square
Use SEPTA or rideshare for late-night travel — avoid walking in unfamiliar areas after midnight
The sports complex area in South Philly is heavily managed on match days
Philly summer heat and humidity can be intense — hydrate consistently at outdoor events
Lock valuables in your hotel safe and be aware in crowded spots like Reading Terminal Market
